subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 448 (EXT.F(II)-10). C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INT: TR, PHY-U-C (physical universe context) and PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PHY-U-C: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism).
